Hold the world.

The traverse is the ocean. ChatJLM is the operator console on top of it: a work chat that routes every mission through the Loki corps, shows its progress, keeps its outputs, and grows what you learn into planetary groves.

Wave field, not a second sun

Connectivity is drawn as coupled oscillators and nadi-like channels. Routing weighs several candidates at once; it is a metaphor, not a claim about consciousness.

Dvaita lock, shared fabric

Each agent keeps a locked identity and its world's grove. Shared evidence is the sky they write into, never a merger of agents.

Shadow first

Every mission records the intended action next to what actually ran. Writes wait for your approval until you open the cloak.

Nadi, chakra and rasa plates are operational metaphors. The celestial scenes are compressed illustrations, not an ephemeris. The traverse's black-hole hold is a visual study; Deep transit's lens traces bent light per pixel, with the horizon scale dramatized. The sixteen Astra worlds and their ring are symbolic. The nine worlds are capability domains named for the eight planets and Pluto. Sky-chart positions are calculated; its readings are symbolic, not forecasts.
